evidence_window: Release through 2011-12-31, widened from the original 2009-only audit at the user's direction.
purpose: Provenance and executable reconstruction contracts for the final seven Summoning special moves. Direct period evidence, later source-code corroboration, and inference are deliberately separate. The implementation uses the recorded reconstruction decisions where period sources do not publish a number.

official_baseline.scope: Target class, high-level effect, scroll cost, and XP. Numeric details are used only where the table states them.

shared_reconstruction_policy.npc_targets: Selected and area NPCs must expose attack option 2, be alive when resolved, and remain within eight tiles of the generation-checked familiar.
shared_reconstruction_policy.player_targets: Destructive player effects require owner, familiar, and victim to be in multiway Wilderness, the victim to be within eight tiles of the familiar, and the combat-level difference to fit both tiles' Wilderness levels. This excludes Duel Arena, Castle Wars, ordinary safe areas, the owner, and friendly collateral.
shared_reconstruction_policy.timing: A later server-source sequence is adopted only when it preserves the period-described effect and no conflicting period timing exists.
shared_reconstruction_policy.asset_policy: Local 2009scape IDs are direct source evidence. Later source IDs are imported when the underlying rev-530 cache contains the referenced asset. Phoenix alone uses a named cache-native fallback because no special class or unique special asset survives.

mechanics.target_rules: Immediate owner/familiar self effect; no selected victim. Reject while the familiar generation already holds an unused charge.
mechanics.effects_formula: First cap any above-base current Attack, Strength, Defence, Magic, and Ranged to base. Then Attack and Strength gain floor(15% of base), Defence loses floor(15% of base), Magic loses 5, and Ranged loses floor(10% of base). Arm the familiar's next legal NPC combat swing; that swing always makes its normal hit and has a 50% chance to make one independently accurate second hit.
mechanics.duration_timing: The five stat changes use ordinary stat restoration. The generation-local attack charge has no wall-clock expiry; it waits for and is consumed by the next otherwise-legal adjacent multiway familiar swing, including a miss.
mechanics.caps: Stat operations use the host stat floors/caps. Charged combat adds at most one hit and cannot be stacked.
mechanics.pvp_restrictions: The reconstructed charge consumer is NPC-only because the current familiar combat loop has no ordinary familiar-vs-player swing. Its owner, familiar, and NPC target must all be on multiway tiles.

mechanics.effects_formula: Let M be Phoenix base HP and H its HP before cast. Damage cap = floor(50*(M-H)/M); independently roll uniform 0..cap for each eligible victim. Teleport the Phoenix onto the ashes and heal it to full.
mechanics.duration_timing: Play the cache-native Phoenix fall/ready sequence, wait two ticks, revalidate and consume ashes, teleport/full-heal/replay sequence, then resolve the 3x3 burst.
mechanics.caps: Maximum 50 damage; radius one (3x3); maximum five total NPC/player victims.
mechanics.pvp_restrictions: NPCs use the shared attackability rule. Players are damaged only under the shared multiway-Wilderness policy; Duel Arena and the historical non-PvP multiway bug are excluded.
